gradient_cache_geometry_members.warning: Do not invoke load_gradient_cache in a label-free preparation: that loader decompresses reference_cell_tensor_strain as well. Access only explicitly named geometry members, or H5 vertices/cells. corner_ids are the four-corner P1 proxy; they are not sufficient for the all-node context graph.

graph_choice.nodes: All original TETRA10 nodes, including all six mids
graph_choice.construction: For each corner pair (a,b) with its mid m, include (a,m) and (m,b); canonicalize undirected endpoint pairs and unique before CSR
exclusions: No tetrahedral clique or face diagonal
graph_choice.weight_semantics: Existing graph-distance cache uses physical edge length/L as a path cost. Reuse its structural edges, not its distance costs as an unannounced diffusion weighting.

draft_from_research_not_a_release.fine_adjacency: Symmetric positive binary W on actual unique subedges only
draft_from_research_not_a_release.P0: One-hot owner map of connected, exact original 0:7 BC-bitmask homogeneous aggregates
draft_from_research_not_a_release.coarse_adjacency: Hard P0 contraction of actual crossedges, remove diagonal; positive crossing multiplicities; second-level owners inherit exact BC signature
draft_from_research_not_a_release.positivity_and_partition_of_unity: For positive degrees and 0 < omega <= 1, J is nonnegative row-stochastic. Therefore J^2 P0 is nonnegative and row sums remain one. The proposed omega=2/3 yields diagonal 1/3. These properties need numeric cache checks, not clipping/renormalization that hides failures.
draft_from_research_not_a_release.BC_mixing: Hard owners preserve exact roles; smoothing may mix neighboring roles and must explicitly record that distinction. Query raw BC features remain unchanged.
draft_from_research_not_a_release.control: Neighbor and self-only modes must share owners, prolongation, target-independent inputs, feature widths, initialization and sampling; only message-neighbor aggregation differs. Exact fairness/architecture is for root to freeze.
draft_from_research_not_a_release.control_limit: A self-only message control with the same graph-smoothed P still contains topology through the shared aggregation/interpolation. Its comparison isolates learned neighbor-message coupling, not the presence of all topology information.

aggregation_blockers_to_measure.necessary_lower_bound: The number of connected components in each exact 7-bit BC role induced subgraph lower-bounds the number of role-homogeneous aggregates. Full graph connectedness does not establish that the 4096/512 caps are feasible.
aggregation_blockers_to_measure.determinism: Canonical node/neighbor order plus predeclared seed; target size is not achieved by merging nonadjacent components or unlike roles.
aggregation_blockers_to_measure.BC_preservation: All nodes are assigned; keep exact role signatures and per-aggregate source membership counts/binary max, with node-level roles retained. Do not discard rare support/load members via point sampling, replace them with master coordinates, or threshold averaged roles into a new signature.
required_cache_checks: Every original node has exactly one nonempty owner at each hard level
Each hard aggregate is connected in its actual-edge graph and role-homogeneous
Coarse adjacency contains only actual crossing edges
Source members are represented with original GRID-to-node alignment
Hard safety cap, nonnegative weights and row sums are satisfied
Report P nnz and row-support min/median/p95/max; no top-k or threshold pruning

runtime.autograd_API_note: The installed torch.sparse.mm documentation supports CSR @ dense backward. Sparse @ sparse backward is not supported. The context cache is static; dense learned feature gradients are the required path. No actual sparse operation or CUDA runtime has been tested here.

memory_and_cost.kind: Derived upper bounds and storage estimates, not measured preparation or training performance
memory_and_cost.warning: Two sparse Jacobi passes expand each P0 row to aggregate IDs within two hops. If explicit P approaches dense N x aggregate_count, preparation memory and per-batch backward can become prohibitive. Do not densify P or silently prune its support.
memory_and_cost.algebraically_equivalent_storage_option: If root selects it, store hard owners and J CSR and apply J @ (J @ owner_gather(coarse_features)) to dense N x channels. This avoids explicit prolongation fill-in and is algebraically the same smoother, but still has full-node dense intermediates and sparse backward cost; it is not a different model candidate.
memory_and_cost.timing: No new geometry/aggregation/smoothing was executed, so aggregate cost and GPU throughput remain unknown.

proposed_cache_contract_only.scope: Exactly the four declared TRAIN CADs for feasibility, with split/source identities
proposed_cache_contract_only.geometry: XYZ normalized <f4 SHA; physical source stat; L/bbox; original node order; cells10/edge hashes
proposed_cache_contract_only.indices: fine_owner[node], coarse_owner[fine_aggregate], hard role signatures, level CSR actual adjacency, sparse prolongation crow/col/value arrays or equivalent fixed operators
proposed_cache_contract_only.BC: Exact original input 0:7 masks, source-group identities/counts and role homogeneous owners; no target fields
proposed_cache_contract_only.identity: Generator/source SHA and frozen recipe SHA; per-CAD shapes/dtypes/stat/hash; metadata-only loader separate from array loading
proposed_cache_contract_only.failure: Block on missing/multivalued source mapping, isolated graph rows, uncovered nodes, too many role components, cap overflow, nonfinite values or invalid row sums. Do not fill or clip.

limitations: This is mesh-message context on observed mesh nodes, not a stiffness matrix, elasticity solver, or exact geodesic.
Positive graph smoothing does not prove a bandlimited continuous field or accurate displacement derivatives.
A node-index context cannot be honestly extended to arbitrary xyz by nearest constant lookup; any later off-node context requires a separately declared mesh interpolation policy.
No train, validation, final-test, stress, displacement, DIA, checkpoint or optimizer arrays were read. No new job or training code is created by this note.
